messages.content: You are a concise NLP research assistant.
Supervised fine-tuning trains a pretrained model on labeled examples of desired inputs and responses.
LoRA trains low-rank adapter matrices while keeping the pretrained model weights frozen.
Why use a held-out evaluation set?
A held-out set measures generalization on examples not used for training.
It sums gradients over several micro-batches before one optimizer step, simulating a larger batch.
Warmup increases the learning rate gradually at the start of training to avoid unstable updates.
Direct preference optimization trains a policy on chosen versus rejected responses without a reward model.
Does it need a reference model?
Yes, the loss compares policy and reference log-probability ratios.
Fully sharded data parallel splits parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across GPUs.
A Jinja template that turns role-tagged messages into the exact token format a chat model was trained on.
